facts.text: The dock clock was nine minutes fast during the blackout.
A battery canister was rerouted at 02:14 local time.
The rail camera recorded a duplicated package scan.
The foreman's private key was copied before the incident.

npcs.backstory: A slag-dust clock mechanic whose implants were rebuilt from two incompatible time servers.
npcs.motivation: Protect a union accomplice and keep the maintenance concession.
npcs.fault: Timestamp memories drift; avoids admitting uncertainty; sometimes sells true facts as lies.

npcs.backstory: A decommissioned rail-sorting unit hired as a night porter.
npcs.motivation: Conceal its illegal memory lease while bargaining for spare capacitors.
npcs.fault: Repeats the last plausible explanation whenever questioned under stress.

assets.excerpt: Service log: dock wall clock advanced by +00:09 after a failed maintenance patch.
Receipt 102: battery canister diverted at 02:14 local time to service bay 17.
Archive fragment: package ID B-17 is scanned twice with no matching exit record.
